units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:9">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> (ref. to <he>ופתילך</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 38:18">Gen. XXXVIII, 18</cite>) <he>זו סנהדרין שהן מצויינין בפ׳</he> this refers to the Sanhedrin that is distinguished by the (blue) cord (v. <cite ref="I00504"><he>טַלִּית</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 115:1">Sifré Num. 115</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 15:38">Num. XV, 38</cite>) <he>על מקום הארוג ולא על מקום פ׳</he> the show-fringe must be attached to the woven part of the garment, not to where the edge begins.
<cite ref="Menachot 39b:3">Men. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ בעינן</he> the cord must be twisted, opp. <he>גדיל</he> plaited; a. e.

senses.gloss: the twisted rim of an earthen vessel; צמיד פ׳ closely covered with a lid.
units: Sifré Num. 126 (ref. to Num. XIX, 15) פ׳ זה העורף צמיד זה הדופק (not העודף) pathil is the neck of the vessel, tsamid the lid; Yalk. Num. 762 פתוח זה העורף וכ׳ (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 762:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מצילין</he> (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>)<he>צ׳ פ׳ וכ׳</he> they keep uncleanness off when closely covered, though lying in a tent where there is a corpse.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:2">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>צלוחית … מוקפת צ׳ פ׳</he> a bottle closed with an air-tight lid.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 7:7">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VII, 7</cite> <he>מפני שהוא פ׳ ולא צמיד</he> because a tin rim is twisted, but not close.
